# msdfgen core

Unmodified core sources from [msdfgen v1.13](https://github.com/Chlumsky/msdfgen/tree/v1.13),
commit `1874bcf7d9624ccc85b4bc9a85d78116f690f35b`. This copy includes
`core/`, `msdfgen.h`, and the upstream MIT license. Shotglass provides contours
from skrifa and builds the core with `cc`, so the CLI and extensions are omitted.
